paras: Upgrade your Subaru 's front braking performance with DIXCEL brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the DIXCEL brake rotor types shown for the latest generation of Subaru vehicles sharing the same 316x28mm front brake fitment, including the new WRX (VB) sedan and WRX Sportwagon (VN) 2022 onwards non-Brembo variants with the 2.4L FA24E turbocharged engine, the Outback (BT) 2022 onwards with the AWD XT turbocharged engine, the Forester (SK) 2018-2025 with the 2.5L FB25C engine, and the Forester Hybrid (SK) 2019-2025 with the 2.0L FB20W hybrid powertrain.
